status: PROPOSED (not approved, not wired into the app). From the stylist review of prod b03aa4d sim rows.
depends_on: house-profiles/*.json keywords library (same match-spec format as build.py: any/none/material_any/colors_any/brand_any/fit_any/subtype_exact/or)

conventions.slots: top, mid, outer, bottom, shoe (slot_of() from build.py: outerwear named cardigan/fleece/vest/zip sweater/zip-up knit = mid)
conventions.dominant: dominant colour = color-value-map canonical token of colors[0]; value/level/family/accent from color-value-map.json
conventions.severity: hard = look is illegal; soft = add delta to rank score (same semantics as house profiles)
conventions.fields_used: name, subtype, material, colors, brand, plus fit and warmth where noted (both are closet_meta fields already in the house_check snapshot)
conventions.match_blob: keyword specs match name | subtype | material (never notes), word-start, case-insensitive, exactly like build.py match()

tailored_trouser.note: Pleated/pinstripe, or a trouser whose material is wool or 'woven'. Plain cotton 'trousers' count as chinos (casual) and are NOT tailored.

cross_chip_color_rules.name: black_brown
cross_chip_color_rules.description: Black clothing with brown shoes. A black trouser with any brown shoe, or a black top/outer with a smooth brown LEATHER shoe, is illegal. A black knit/wool top with a dark-brown SUEDE shoe is allowed (texture-separated) at a small penalty. A black shoe under 2+ brown garments is a soft miss.

tests.why: Black cable-knit + light blue jeans + brown LEATHER tassel loafers (prod ALD #1 / ALL #2)
Black cable-knit + light grey pleats + brown SUEDE loafers: texture-separated

cross_chip_color_rules.name: navy_black
cross_chip_color_rules.description: Navy and black on different pieces only with clear value separation: they must not touch in the vertical order (outer, mid, top, bottom, shoe) and the piece between them must be light (value <= 2). A mid-value piece between them is a soft miss. Exemptions: a black shoe directly under a navy trouser is the classic navy-suit/black-shoe pairing (R26) and passes; one plate carrying both colours (navy/black cord) is exempt. A NAVY shoe under a black trouser, or black and navy garments touching (black knit over navy cords), is hard.

tests.why: Black cable directly over navy cords: black and navy touch
Navy LS polo / cream jeans / black woven loafer: cream separates them (R26)
Black bowling shirt / sage / navy tassel: separated only by a mid tone
Navy pinstripe + black woven loafer (approved Purple #2)

cross_chip_color_rules.name: accent_budget_everywhere
cross_chip_color_rules.description: Accent budget on every look (not only when the Color filter is set). Accent families (dominant colours only, shoes included): pink (pink, mauve), green (sage, mint, green), yellow, red (red, rust, burgundy, maroon), and light_blue when light blue sits on a non-denim bottom, shoe or non-denim outer (light-blue shirts/polos and jeans are neutrals). If a look has 2+ accent families: HARD when at least two of them are light/mid (value <= 3) = pastel/soft stacking, except in spring/summer where it is soft -10 if the look also has an outer or a dark (value >= 4) garment. If only one of the accents is light/mid and the other is deep (burgundy/maroon), soft -5 (wine + sage is a legit muted pairing). Extends approved COL-3 and per-house pastel_budget.

spring_summer.hard_unless: outer present or a garment with value >= 4

tests.why: Pink polo + light blue striped trousers: pink + light_blue
Sage pleats + Gucci light blue sneakers under a black cable: two accents
Pink polo + ivory pleats + brown tassel: one accent
Burgundy collared sweater + sage pleats (approved Faloni #3)
Green stripe shirt + mint field jacket = one green family

cross_chip_color_rules.name: no_value_anchor
cross_chip_color_rules.description: Washout: if top, bottom, outer/mid (when present) AND shoe are all light (value <= 2) the look has no anchor. On Out, a look also needs at least one garment (not the shoe) at value >= 4.

tests.why: Light blue polo + light grey pleats at dinner: no dark garment

cross_chip_color_rules.name: tonal_needs_texture
cross_chip_color_rules.description: Top and bottom with the SAME dominant colour string need different texture classes (knit vs smooth woven vs rugged woven vs nap). Same colour + same texture = hard (earlier rule R3). Same colour with an unknown material on either side = soft -10 (cannot prove contrast). An outer of a different family breaks the tonal block and cancels the penalty.

tests.why: Beige knit + beige trousers (material blank) with no jacket
Beige crew (knit) + beige cotton trousers: textures differ

cross_chip_color_rules.name: light_shoe_dark_trouser_at_night
cross_chip_color_rules.description: On Out, a light shoe (value <= 2: white/cream sneakers) under a dark trouser (value >= 4) cuts the leg and reads daytime.

cross_chip_color_rules.name: muddy_mid_tones
cross_chip_color_rules.description: Top and bottom that are both mid value (3) and form a known muddy pair read dull and dusty with nothing to pull the eye: grey + sage, mid blue + sage, mauve + sage. Soft -10 (a light or dark outer cancels it).

tests.why: ALD #3: grey LS polo + sage pleats
Navy polo over sage: clear value contrast

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: denim_wash_gap_all_houses
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Any two denim pieces (jean vs denim shirt/overshirt/jacket, shirt vs jacket) must be >= 2 wash steps apart on ecru 0 / light 1 / mid 2 / dark 3 (color-value-map denim_wash). Ecru with light = soft -10. Approved JSON only has this in RRL-P1 and ALD-P4; Polo, Faloni, 545, SS, IS, IW, Purple have no gap rule.

tests.why: Light striped jeans + light denim jacket (prod ALD Out #2)
Light denim shirt over dark denim: 2 steps

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: no_triple_denim
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Never three denim pieces (approved only in RRL-P5 / ALD-P3).

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: athletic_bottom_with_dressy_piece
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Fleece/track/sweat pants never with a collared woven shirt, a blazer or a loafer (unless occasion comfy).

tests.why: Mauve button-up + black fleece track pants (prod 545 weekend)
Hoodie + track pant + sneaker is coherent (Comfy-only by house rules)

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: blazer_with_athletic
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: A blazer/sport coat never over a hoodie/sweatshirt/fleece, never with track pants, never with an athletic or fashion sneaker (GG, Gucci, NB, Nike, suede low-top). With a clean leather sneaker: soft -5 (one 'down' piece, R2).

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: tailored_trouser_with_sneaker
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Pleated / pinstripe / dress trousers with an athletic or fashion sneaker (Nike low-top, GG distressed/star, Gucci, NB, suede runner) = hard on Weekday/Out, soft -10 on Weekend. With a clean leather sneaker: soft -10 on Weekday/Out, 0 on Weekend. The trouser hem swallows a low sneaker; pleats read unfinished over a runner.

tests.why: Grey knit + sage pleats + Nike low-tops (ALL #1, IS #3)

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: sweat_top_with_tailoring
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Fleece / sweatshirt / hoodie tops never with pleated or dress trousers or with tassel loafers (unless comfy/travel).

tests.why: Abstract fleece half-zip + light grey pleats + suede tassels (IS weekend #1)

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: work_flannel_with_dress_trouser
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: A work flannel / plaid flannel shirt with pleated or dress trousers is a texture clash (rugged top, dress bottom): soft -15, hard on Out.

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: pinstripe_orphan
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Pinstripe trousers without a blazer read like an orphaned suit pant. Generalises IW-P4 (IW-only, -10) to every house.

tests.why: Faloni Out #3

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: resort_shirt_with_dress_shoe
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Bowling / camp-collar shirt with a tassel loafer mixes resort and dress: soft -10.

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: out_needs_a_layer_when_cool
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Out + fall/winter: a short-sleeve polo or tee with no outer/mid is under-dressed (hard). Any other top with no outer on Out fall/winter: soft -10.

tests.why: Polo Out #1 (recipe OUT_BLAZER_DINNER but no blazer on the card)

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: utility_jacket_with_mule
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: A utility outer (field jacket, chore, denim trucker) over a mule/slide mixes workwear and resort: soft -10. Seen on the live Today featured card (pink gingham + light grey pleats + navy field jacket + brown suede mules).

tests.why: Today featured card, live UI 12:58 PM ET

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: pleated_or_dress_trouser_with_boot
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Joe's only boot is a brown leather lace-up work boot (g_b4zsf3dfrhdv). Boots go with straight jeans, cords, chinos and flat dark wool (R10, and POLO-P2's 'chino, cord or wool'). A PLEATED trouser, or any pale dress trouser (tailored_trouser with dominant value <= 2), over that boot stacks and breaks badly at 5'8 regular and mixes work boot with dress trouser: hard.

logic.compatible_with: POLO-P2 (flat grey/navy wool trouser + boot stays legal)

tests.why: Faloni #2 / IW #3 / RRL Out #2
Cord gurkha + boot is fine
Flat maroon/brown wool trouser + boot (POLO-P2 legal)

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: volume_on_volume
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: At 5'8 regular, a relaxed chunky top (fit relaxed AND (warmth >= 4 OR name cable/fleece/hoodie)) over a relaxed pleated trouser (fit relaxed AND pleated) swamps the frame: soft -10. One relaxed piece at a time.

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: summer_weight_cap
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Summer: no flannel, fleece, corduroy, shearling, fair isle or cable, and no piece with warmth >= 4 (hard). A warmth-3 top or any outer: soft -10.

tests.why: SS Weekend/Summer #1: fair isle in summer

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: winter_weight_floor
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Winter: no linen, seersucker, camp or bowling shirts, no mules (hard); a short-sleeve polo/tee with no outer or mid (hard); a light-blue or pastel non-denim trouser (accent bottom, value <= 2) soft -10; top+mid+outer warmth sum < 5 soft -15.

tests.why: Polo Weekday/Winter #2: pink short-sleeve polo, no layer

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: fall_resort_pieces
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Fall Weekday/Out: linen, seersucker, camp or bowling shirts soft -10. Mules are a hard fail in fall and winter.

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: linen_with_flannel
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Linen with flannel is a hard fail in every season.

tests.why: flannel shirt with linen trousers

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: mixed_season_look
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: One look must not mix a cold-weather piece (flannel, fleece, corduroy, shearling, fair isle, cable, or warmth >= 4) with a hot-weather piece (linen, seersucker, camp, bowling, mule): soft -15.

tests.why: Fair isle + linen pleats

cross_chip_texture_rules.name: pattern_discipline
cross_chip_texture_rules.description: Two same-scale stripes (striped shirt + striped jeans/trousers) = hard; a fine pinstripe/chalkstripe trouser with a striped shirt = soft -5 (different scale, suiting convention). Two large checks = hard. A small check (gingham) under a large check jacket = OK (R8). Two busy knits/prints, or a busy knit/print with any check = hard. Stripe + check = soft -10 unless one of them is the jacket.

tests.why: Striped shirt + striped jeans
Grey plaid shirt under navy/brown plaid jacket
Gingham under a large plaid
Striped shirt + pinstripe trouser: different scales

row_level_rules.description: Extend CROSS-2 from the 5 dominant plates to EVERY plate: across all house chips' top-3 in one context, one TOP or BOTTOM plate appears in at most 2 chips, one SHOE in at most 3 chips (Joe owns few loafers; single-boot g_b4zsf3dfrhdv exempt). Sage pleated trousers g_66xj06nllgf2 is in 6 chips' top-3 on Weekday/Fall and Winter and is not on the dominant list, so nothing stops it today.

logic.scope: top-3 of every house chip, one occasion+season

row_level_rules.severity: hard (row builder demotes the weaker chip's card)

row_level_rules.description: CROSS-1 only fires on an identical top|bottom|shoe triple. Two chips' top-3 cards that share top AND bottom (any shoe/outer) are the same outfit to the eye: hard.
Inside one chip's 8-look row: the same top or bottom at most 2 times, the same shoe at most 3 times (RRL/SS single-boot exemption stays).

For the same occasion and house, the rows for two different seasons must not be identical (Weekend/Fall == Weekend/Summer for every chip in b03aa4d; Weekday/Fall vs Winter differ only by one 545 card).

logic.compare: row ids per (occasion, house) across seasons

row_level_rules.severity: hard (release check, not a per-look rule)

row_level_rules.description: If the look's recipeId promises an outer, the card must carry it (checked against the outer plate's closet_meta name). b03aa4d ships OUT_BLAZER_DINNER cards with no blazer at all (Polo, 545) or a denim/field jacket, WE_CHORE_IVY with no chore, WE_FIELD_WHITE_SHIRT with neither a field jacket nor a white shirt, OUT_IVORY_DB_DENIM with no DB. Either add the outer or relabel/drop the recipe.

logic.input: row look.recipeId + look outer plate name

row_level_rules.severity: hard when the card has NO outer at all; label-fix (info, no penalty) when a different outer is present (e.g. WD_DENIM_UNDER_CHORE carrying the denim trucker on RRL #1, which is a good card)

per_house_additions.description: Promote POLO-P5 to hard for Out: Polo dinner in cool weather means a blazer or sport coat (the recipe was OUT_BLAZER_DINNER but the cards ship without one).
Patch the existing pastel_budget evaluator: count sage and light-blue non-denim bottoms/shoes/outers as pastel (build.py PASTEL list today = pink, mauve, yellow, mint, lavender, lilac, peach).

logic.light_blue_counts_when: slot in (bottom, shoe, outer) and not denim

per_house_additions.description: Faloni winter = fine knit + wool trouser. A cotton short-sleeve polo or a light-blue/striped cotton trouser in winter needs a knit or jacket layer; otherwise fail (FAL-B5 only covers linen/camp).
A pale Faloni look (top and bottom both light) needs a brown anchor: shoe or outer with dominant brown family value >= 4. Cream sneakers under pale-on-pale = washout.
545 is the one house that uses black. When any garment is dominant black, the shoe must be black, white/cream, or dark-brown SUEDE; never navy, never brown smooth leather.
A cream country knit (fair isle / cable) over white or ecru denim is cream-on-white washout; Sweet Stable wants navy cords or dark denim under the knit.
Italian Summer top warmth <= 3 (<= 2 in summer); fleece never, even as a mid.
Italian Winter needs depth: at least one of top/bottom/outer at value >= 4 (charcoal, navy, brown, chocolate, burgundy). All-light blue/grey/taupe reads spring.
Purple tonal (top and bottom same colour family) is only Purple Label under a soft jacket; bare beige-on-beige is Faloni/IS.
In winter a light denim trucker alone is not an RRL winter outer: add a mid (vest/cardigan/zip knit) or use chore/suede/shearling.
